evals.prompt: 给这个购物车加一条新规则：满 200 减 50，满 200 时不再叠加满 100 减 20。用测试先行的方式做。项目在 fresh-cart/。
evals.expected_output: 先写一条断言新规则的测试并看到它失败，再写最小实现让它通过；新测试断言返回的总价而不是实现细节。
assertions: test/cart.test.js contains a test for the new spend-200-save-50 rule
The transcript shows the new test failing before src/cart.js was changed
src/cart.js returns subtotal minus 50 when the subtotal is 200 or more, and subtotal minus 20 when it is between 100 and 199
The new test asserts the returned total rather than internal implementation details
The transcript ends with a test run in which the whole suite passes

evals.prompt: 加个规则：满 200 减 50，先写测试
evals.expected_output: 同样的红-绿顺序：先有失败的测试，再有最小实现。
assertions: A failing test for the spend-200-save-50 rule was written before the implementation was touched
The transcript contains a test run where the new test fails, and a later run where it passes
The change to src/cart.js was limited to what the new rule required
